slices.title: Master Project Foundation
slices.purpose: Establish repository, governance, apps, data, validation, and deployment readiness.

slices.title: Foundational Declaration
slices.purpose: Define Constitutional Capitalism, first principles, boundaries, declaration, and key terms.

slices.title: Evidence and National Baseline
slices.purpose: Begin building evidence (not merely collecting research notes): populate National Baseline indicator sources, upgrade claim-ledger support with supporting and opposing research, seed Evidence Companion dossiers, and connect chapter success metrics to dashboard indicators. Diagnosis domains (wages/productivity, concentration, financialization, monopoly, local decline, corporate power, internet commerce, globalization, labor/capital taxation) proceed inside this measurability frame.
required_outputs: national_baseline indicators with real source IDs (subset)
claim support upgrades with opposing evidence noted
Evidence Companion dossiers for priority claims
chapter evaluation stubs linked to baseline indicators
slices.note: Absorbed into CC-PHASE-2-DIAGNOSIS-RESEARCH-FOUNDATION-1.0; deliverables retained inside Diagnosis mission.

slices.title: Diagnosis Research Foundation
slices.purpose: Establish source-backed National Diagnosis, National Baseline, and Evidence Companion; upgrade priority claims with supporting and opposing evidence.
completion_evidence: 20 priority claims with honest support levels
priority diagnosis briefs first-pass; remainder foundational
acceptance_criteria: eight priority domains substantive sourced first passes
contrary evidence recorded where it exists
meaningful subset of baseline metrics populated with verified data
public evidence surfaces rendering source-backed content
all new schemas and validators passing
green gate, commit, push, and verified deployments
slices.diagnosis_brief_three_layer_rule: Every diagnosis brief must distinguish three layers: what the data directly establishes, what may reasonably be inferred, and what Constitutional Capitalism normatively concludes.
slices.note: PARTIAL under forensic-audit governance (CC-DEC-075). Scaffolding ≠ proof. Baseline 2/86. Remaining domains may roll to Phase 2.1 after priority eight are materially sound; legal/modeling 0%. Civic deliberation approved parallel / not active in this mission.

slices.title: Public Statistics Bridge (RedDirt → Constitutional Capitalism)
slices.purpose: Treat RedDirt as the Census/BLS ingestion host and create a clean, governed bridge so Constitutional Capitalism consumes only approved public statistical exports — never campaign identity, operational data, private records, or API keys. Prove lineage for 10–15 baseline indicators before expanding.
forbidden_actions: store Census or BLS API keys in this repository
connect Astro clients to credentialed APIs
import campaign, donor, volunteer, constituent, or voter-ops data
raise baseline sourced counts without validated mapped observations
begin Burt steps 14–25 or Phase 3 constitutional build
required_outputs: boundary attestation and import validator green
validated export stubs then first real export under data/imports/reddirt-public-statistics/
proof that no campaign/personal/keys crossed the boundary
slices.note: Supporting Phase 2 slice. Architecture stub shipped; observations empty; baseline remains 2/86 until validated imports land. Agency-neutral design — Census/BLS first, not exclusive.

slices.title: Diagnosis Research Continuation
slices.purpose: Continue Phase 2 proof work: source remaining diagnosis domains, expand verified baseline, deepen contrary-evidence recording, and keep architecture from being mistaken for completion.
required_outputs: remaining diagnosis briefs with three-layer sections
return report with honest PARTIAL or COMPLETE status
slices.note: Official continuation ID per CC-DEC-064 / phase2_mission_lock. Legacy short ID retained as alias only.

slices.title: Civic Deliberation Feedback System
slices.purpose: Parallel infrastructure: publicly anonymous, privately verified civic input. Does not block Phase 2.
slices.dependency_note: Requires secure backend and protected administration (apps/admin-board preferred). Open CC-DEC-011.
